description: Crypto market overview: total cap, dominance, trending. Crypto market snapshot: total market cap and 24h volume (USD), 24h market-cap change, BTC/ETH dominance, active coins, plus the top trending coins (name, symbol, market-cap rank, price, 24h change). Deterministic, no LLM. Example output: {"totalMarketCapUsd":3100000000000,"totalVolumeUsd":120000000000,"marketCapChange24hPct":-0.8,"dominance":{"btc":57.1,"eth":11.9},"trending":[{"name":"Bitcoin","symbol":"BTC","rank":1,"priceUsd":100000,"change24hPct":1.2}]}. Price: $0.004 USDC on Base via x402 (pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"]).

trending.description: Optional: number of trending coins to include (1-15, default 10)
